conflictsOfInterest: The reviewer is the project founder and owner. The review records that role explicitly; it is an internal owner decision, not independent external validation.
method: Guided review on 2026-11-17 from a one-page packet: the eight requirements and their obtained evidence, the privacy review (threats, residual risks, convergence findings A1-A8), the owner decisions OD-1 to OD-3 of 2026-11-13, and the code and spec changes since the freeze (only the SPEC-075 export and the approved additive purge output in lightning_cli.py).

humanReview.rationale: Approve SPEC-074 as an engineering specification within its documented scope: consent none or redacted with default none and preview-digest confirmation, store refusal without consent, pattern redaction with the canary corpus in five encodings, retention and purge with an injected clock, the standard-library adapter with keyed HMAC pseudonyms per kind, read-only System One access, and the socket, subprocess and MCP boundaries. Accepted limits as documented: real host transcripts cannot be read yet (A2), pseudonyms are not anonymization and rolloutId is not pseudonymized (A7), redaction catches known shapes only, retention applies when a command or append runs (A1), and no telemetry is recorded (A3).

milestoneClosure.rationale: Confirms the BL.4 closure of 2026-11-14. This does not approve collecting real host transcripts, any export, or execution authority.
